Maintainer (Sam), 2026-10-26 13:11Z, verbatim: 「还是 ObjectStack 的运行时就叫 ObjectOS ，社区版免费，然后企业版是收费的」; at 13:18Z chose 「模型 2：ObjectOS 三版本」 on the decision card 「采用「ObjectOS 一个产品三个版本，ObjectStack 是协议与框架名」吗？」. Edition model: ObjectOS Community (this repository's runtime + Console, self-hosted, free) / ObjectOS Cloud / ObjectOS Enterprise; ObjectStack = the protocol, SDK, CLI and framework name.

Two lines of this card's scope change accordingly; nothing else does:

- **Scope item 1, the ObjectOS sentence under the GIF** ("Want the same loop hosted, in the browser, nothing to install? That's ObjectOS, the commercial runtime environment built on this stack.") becomes a "run it" line with the three editions: what this repository ships is ObjectOS Community (the `ghcr.io/objectstack-ai/objectstack` image, `os start`, the Console); hosted is ObjectOS Cloud; self-managed and licensed is ObjectOS Enterprise. One sentence, two links (objectos.ai, the Ship-it section).
- **Scope item 6, "You own it"**: the "no open-core asterisks" wording becomes the honest form the ruling implies — everything needed to run an app is in this repository (runtime, Console, permissions, audit, MCP, the whole protocol); Cloud and Enterprise add hosting and multi-environment operations, Build & Ask, SSO and support. Keep the Apache-2.0 / MIT (`ui/`) sentence from the original item.

Line 322 ("ObjectStack Cloud control plane") stays out of this card: it is on the naming card filed today in this repository together with the CLI help strings and the Console i18n (search the title "brand(runtime): the hosted product is \"ObjectOS Cloud\"").
